name: Wasteland SPECIAL
edition: A d20 take on SPECIAL for Fallout: New Vegas style play

coverage.summary: d20 plus SPECIAL and skill against a difficulty, hit points, radiation, caps, guns with ammo and clips, and fights resolved by these rules on Classic or Tactical.

gm.checkGuidance: This game uses Wasteland SPECIAL, a d20 system for the Fallout setting. When the outcome of a risky or uncertain action is in doubt, call for a check with one skill on the sheet and pick a difficulty from the ladder: Barter, Speech and Chance for dealing and luck, Medicine and Science for knowledge, Repair, Lockpick and Sneak for craft and stealth, Survival for the wastes, and Guns, Energy Weapons, Melee Weapons, Unarmed and Explosives for violence outside a fight. The Engine rolls the d20 and adds the numbers from the sheet. Never write the result yourself.
gm.sheetGuidance: The character sheets below are authoritative. Hit points are the only health. Radiation is a track from 0 to 8: raise it for hot zones and tainted water or food, lower it when RadAway is used. A crippled limb is a condition, treated by a Doctor bag or a night's rest. Record Stimpaks, RadAway and other healing with the sheet commands, and record bottle caps as money. There is no VATS and no action points; a fight is one action and a move each turn. At the start of the game, give each character a starting kit from the Outfitter with the inventory command: one weapon that matches their best skill, a few rounds of matching ammunition or energy cells, one armor, a Stimpak or two, a canteen and some caps. Weapons only work in a fight while worn, and a gun needs ammunition tagged for it to reload. At 8 radiation a character is dying and dies without RadAway or a doctor.
gm.worldGuidance: Set in the Mojave Wasteland of 2281 as in Fallout: New Vegas: factions in conflict, scarce clean water and medicine, caps as money, ruins, creatures and radiation.

entries.label: Field Surgeon
entries.summary: Treats injuries quickly in the field.

values.name: Field Surgeon
values.notes: Medicine checks to treat crippled limbs and wounds are easier.

values.name: Cautious Nature
values.notes: Survival and Sneak checks to spot ambushes are easier.

entries.label: Silver Tongue
entries.summary: Talks his way out of trouble.

values.name: Silver Tongue
values.notes: Speech and Barter checks against strangers are easier.

values.name: Gunslinger
values.notes: Wins ties on initiative; pistol shots are easier.

values.name: Tinkerer
values.notes: Repair and Science checks are easier.

values.name: Vault Raised
values.notes: Science and Medicine are easier; Survival and Barter on the surface are harder.

entries.label: 9mm pistol
entries.summary: A reliable sidearm, the most common gun in the Mojave.

entries.label: .357 revolver
entries.summary: Heavy, slow to reload, hits hard.

entries.label: Combat armor
entries.summary: Military issue; the NCR Rangers wear it.

entries.label: Stimpak
entries.summary: Boosts healing; heals about 10 hit points when used.

entries.label: Doctor's bag
entries.summary: Mends crippled limbs and treats injuries; three uses between rests.

entries.label: Rad-X
entries.summary: Taken before exposure; resist radiation for an hour.

entries.label: Anti-venom
entries.summary: Cures poison from cazadores and scorpions.

entries.label: Cazador
entries.summary: Mutated tarantula hawk. Erratic, fast, lethal venom.

entries.label: Viper gunslinger
entries.summary: A Viper ambusher with an old rifle or pistol.

entries.label: Fiend
entries.summary: Chem-crazed raider with a scavenged gun or blade.

entries.label: Powder Ganger
entries.summary: Escaped convict with dynamite and a pistol.

entries.label: Rattler Cole
entries.summary: Viper leader. Cunning, wants clean chems.

layers.label: Hardcore
layers.summary: Water, food and sleep matter. Healing is slower and checks are a little harder.

gm.guidance: Hardcore is on. Track thirst, hunger and sleep in the narration: a character who ignores them suffers a penalty on checks until they drink, eat or rest. Stimpaks and clean water are scarce, so make the party ration them, and a crippled limb needs a Doctor bag or a night's rest.
gm.worldGuidance: Hardcore is on. Clean water, food and medicine are scarce; make the journey itself a hazard.
